steps.title: Open trading application
steps.description: Trader opens the relevant trading workflow.

steps.title: Navigate to credit risk screen
steps.description: Trader navigates across multiple screens to initiate the pre-deal check.

steps.title: Enter trade parameters
steps.description: Trader manually enters trade information across multiple fields.

steps.title: Run credit risk check
steps.description: Trader submits the information for a pre-deal credit risk assessment.

steps.title: Review risk result
steps.description: Risk information is reviewed before the trade can proceed.

steps.title: Modify or approve
steps.description: Risk officer may need to review or modify the result before proceeding.

steps.title: Describe the trade
steps.description: Trader provides mandatory trade parameters through a conversational interface.

steps.title: Validate trade parameters
steps.description: The system identifies and validates required parameters such as lot size, position, issuer and price.

steps.title: Calculate credit risk
steps.description: A machine-learning classification model evaluates the trade and produces a risk classification.

steps.title: Human risk review
steps.description: Risk officers review the result before any trade-related data is modified.
